name: Being One
overview: Scripture reveals the profound unity and oneness in God's nature and His design for human relationships. Isaiah affirms that there is no God besides the LORD, who is the first and the last, emphasizing His singular divine identity (Isaiah 43:10; 44:6). In the New Testament, John declares that the Word was both with God and was God, underscoring the unity within the Godhead (John 1:1), while Jesus speaks of the Father as greater, highlighting distinct persons within this oneness (John 14:28). Additionally, the union of man and wife is described as becoming one flesh (Mark 10:7), and believers are united as children of God through faith in Christ (Galatians 3:26), reflecting the relational oneness God calls His people to embody.
